## Error log

RokDock writes unhandled errors to a log file. If the app showed an error dialog or behaved unexpectedly, please attach or paste the relevant entries from:

- **Windows:** `%APPDATA%\rokdock\logs\rokdock-errors.log`
- **macOS:** `~/Library/Logs/rokdock/rokdock-errors.log`
- **Linux:** `~/.config/rokdock/logs/rokdock-errors.log`

The file may not exist if no errors were logged.
